mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines > 1% over 3 months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and decrease in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 5% and UNRATE falls > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If HOUST rises > 5% and UNRATE falls > 0.2% in 1 month and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 over 3 months and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% YoY signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines > 1% YoY during tightening and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
